handling_notes: Per-participant software-computed metrics (bilateral and left-leg CMJ): jump height from take-off velocity AND from flight time, impulses, eccentric RFD. Vendor/software-derived values: usable for plausibility ranges and estimand-difference illustrations (FP-003), never as reference truth (DB-07).
privacy_notes: 206 physically active individuals (basketball players and students); age, body mass, sex, dominance only; no names.
title: Braking RFD and braking impulse vs push-off force distribution and jump performance (exploratory study dataset)
